Situation Report — Day 27

  • Diplomatic pause: Trump announced a 10-day pause on Iran-targeted energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET). He says it followed an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. First 5-day pause was violated by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.

  • Airspace & Ports

    • Airports closed: Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan — commercial airspace shut across the region (per recent flight scans).
    • Strait of Hormuz: Iran warns ships to avoid unapproved routes. BBC reports seized ships and stranded tankers. Iran continues selective passage for some friendly states.

  • Military movements

    • Germany deployed a second Arrow-3 exoatmospheric interceptor. Direct allied defensive buildup in region.
    • Pentagon: NATO allies taking on more security responsibilities.

  • Northern Border & Incidents

    • Hezbollah activity continues daily across northern border.
    • IDF reservist severely wounded near Bint Jbail during altercation with a terrorist.

  • Iran internal

    • State media/coverage: Khamenei’s coffin prepared; seven-day funeral mapped across Iran.

  • Global

    • Russia: Moscow reports four more drones shot down approaching the city.
    • Reporting: US indirectly warned Iran that Israel might target top Iranian negotiators.
  • 🟢 Good News: Germany’s 2nd Arrow-3 deployed — improves high-altitude interception capability in region.
  • Bottom line: Escalating.
